english.title: Member of registered society's committee fail take steps to secure true and fair view of revenue account

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: cooperative and community benefit societies act 2014

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a member of a registered society's committee, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE REGISTERED SOCIETY'S COMMITTEE..), failed to take all reasonable steps to secure that a revenue account of the society, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE REGISTERED SOCIETY..), complied with section 80(1) of the Co-operative and Community Benefit Societies Act 2014 in that the revenue account did not give a true and fair view of the income and expenditure of the society

(A)_[as a whole,]_
(B)_[in respect of a particular business carried on by it, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PARTICULAR BUSINESS CARRIED OUT..),]_

for the period to which the account related
english.legislation: Contrary to section 80(4)(a) of the Co-operative and Community Benefit Societies Act 2014.

english.notes: Section 80(5) provides that no offence is committed if the person had reasonable grounds to believe, and did believe, that a competent and reliable person was charged with the duty of securing that section 80(1) was complied with and was in a position to discharge that duty.
